precheck.sql: SELECT NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 AS "one" FROM "information_schema"."columns" WHERE ("table_schema" = $1 AND "table_name" = $2 AND "column_name" = $3)) AS "result"

postcheck.sql: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 AS "one" FROM "information_schema"."columns" WHERE ("table_schema" = $1 AND "table_name" = $2 AND "column_name" = $3)) AS "result"

label: Set the initial VIP renewal price (35,000 IQD, 3 months)

execute.description: VIP 3-month packages without a renewal price renew at 35,000 IQD
execute.sql: UPDATE "public"."package" SET "renewalPrice" = 35000, "updatedAt" = now() WHERE "serviceType" = 'VIP' AND "durationMonths" = 3 AND "renewalPrice" IS NULL

postcheck.description: no VIP 3-month package is left without a renewal price, and no IPTV package has one
postcheck.sql: SELECT NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "public"."package" WHERE ("serviceType" = 'VIP' AND "durationMonths" = 3 AND "renewalPrice" IS NULL) OR ("serviceType" = 'IPTV' AND "renewalPrice" IS NOT NULL)) AS "result"
